description: This script extracts app launcher files and dependencies from the Cobalt source tree, packages them into a specified location or zip archive, and can list or return the resource files. It includes functions for copying files, creating directories, and zipping the output.

methods.name: _MakeDir
methods.description: Recursively creates directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: _IsOutDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is under the 'out' directory of the source root.

methods.name: _FindFilesRecursive
methods.description: Recursively finds files matching a glob pattern, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: CopyAppLauncherTools
methods.description: Copies app launcher related files and dependencies to a destination directory or zip archive.

methods.name: _PrepareDestination
methods.description: Prepares the destination directory, converting to absolute path and removing existing directory.

methods.name: _GetSourceFilesList
methods.description: Generates a list of source files to include based on patterns and options.

methods.name: _CopyFiles
methods.description: Copies files from source list to destination directory, maintaining structure.

methods.name: MakeZipArchive
methods.description: Creates a zip archive from a source directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for command-line interface, handling arguments for copying, zipping, or listing files.
